queue.title: The V-counter ROM is readable after all -- the note saying it needed a font table was wrong. It is a menu of nine display modes; drive it and it prints verdicts we can pin.

The opcode-size ROM's picture keeps changing out to 1800 frames and no button moves it, so what we pinned is a snapshot of something still moving. Is it its design, or is our machine not finishing it?
Aurora found that a line pushed entirely off a pane was reported as no loss at all. The hub ruled our fix in today, so it is now buildable: the lost line gets reported with nothing drawn beside it.
Cut panel text now says it was cut: 91 such lines fixed across 28 window sizes. The 67 left are whole tables or controls wider than their pane, which is card d-54.
Found by today's fix: in its first moment a window tells a connected program 'there is no window'. What it should say is a ruling for the hub.
The sound chip's interrupt signal should last one line, not until taken. It changes what a real driver hears, so card d-51 asks whether you want to listen first.
From aeon: a watch never catches the sound chip reading an address. The warning half is landed and aeon is told; the full fix needs a contract change and a ruling later.
Sweep wave 1: both measured fixes landed today. Left: two look-at-it questions for you (how an unreadable save is shown; which rule the two address boxes share).
On bank-switching games an address no longer names one byte over time. Needs a contract change, and no current game needs it yet, so it's worth weighing against the other rows first.

queue.title: You liked the old command palette and this one has no easy way in. You get a written comparison of what the old one did before anyone spends on rebuilding it.
All buildable panel items are done. Left: things for your eyes (look questions 1-33 in the audit page), one hidden raw-data fallback in Objects, and a small slot refresh follow-up.
Nudging individual effect numbers is now buildable. Two constraints: only some fields have a reader at runtime, and the memory it needs is absent in a release build while the entry point resolves.
